org_create.title: Create your organization
org_create.description: You need an organization before you can invite members or manage billing.

org_settings.title: Organization
org_settings.permission_notice: Only owners and admins can change this.
org_settings.name_hint: Shown to every member, and in emails and invitations.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can sign in to your organization, and what they can do.
members.error_role_change: Unable to update this member's role.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.

invitation_accept.title: You're invited
invitation_accept.unavailable_message: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
invitation_accept.accept_hint: Joins this organization with your account
invitation_accept.not_logged_in: Log in or create an account with {email} to accept this invitation.

error.invite_invalid_or_expired: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
error.cannot_demote_last_owner: You can't demote the last owner of an organization.
error.cannot_remove_last_owner: You can't remove the last owner of an organization.

api_keys.title: API keys
api_keys.description: Keys let a third party call this organization's API without a user session. A key is shown once, when it is created.
api_keys.field_name_hint: What this key is for. Only you will see it.
api_keys.field_scopes_hint: What this key may do. Choose the least it needs.
api_keys.field_expires_hint: Leave empty for a key that never expires.
api_keys.created_warning: This is the only time this key will ever be shown. Store it somewhere safe before closing this dialog.
api_keys.revoke_description: Anything using this key stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
api_keys.empty_body: API keys let scripts and integrations call the API as your organization, with only the scopes you grant. Create one to get started — the key itself is shown once.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: We POST an event to your URL when something happens here. Every request is signed; verify the signature before trusting it.
webhooks.field_url_hint: Must be a public https:// address. Private and loopback addresses are rejected.
webhooks.field_events_hint: Which events to send. You can change this later.
webhooks.secret_warning: This is the only time this secret will ever be shown. Your consumer needs it to verify the signature on every request.
webhooks.rotated_warning: The previous secret keeps working until {expires}. Every request is signed with both until then, so you can switch over without downtime.
webhooks.rotate_description: You'll get a new secret straight away. The current one keeps working for {hours} hours, so your consumer can accept either while you deploy.
webhooks.delete_description: We stop sending events to {url}. Its delivery log goes with it. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.replay_hint: Sends the stored payload again as a new delivery
webhooks.replayed: Replayed — a new delivery is on its way.
webhooks.empty_body: Webhooks push events to a URL you control as they happen, so you don't have to poll for them. Add an endpoint and choose which events it should receive.
